articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) is set to host its annual Sales Expo 2025 from September 23–26 at its headquarters in Brookings, South Dakota.
articles.title: Sign Companies and Industry Experts to Gather for Daktronics Sales Expo 2025

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, was asked by the We’re All Mustangs Here foundation, including Pat McAfee, sports analyst and former professional football player, to design, manufacture and install new LED video displays for Plum Senior High School, McAfee’s alma mater, in the Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, area.
articles.title: Plum Senior High School Gets Tech Boost from Daktronics, We’re All Mustangs Here Foundation and Benefactor Pat McAfee

articles.summary: At last month’s IDEA (Information Display & Entertainment Association) Conference, Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, was recognized with the Partner Innovation Award and Partner Community Award while Daktronics’ Professional Services Manager Mark Eisenstadt received the President’s Award.
articles.title: IDEA Conference Recognizes Daktronics with Multiple Awards

articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, is once again providing LED technology at the Denny Sanford PREMIER Center in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, as a digital refresh of the original installation for the building’s opening in 2014.
articles.title: Denny Sanford PREMIER Center Selects Daktronics to Refresh Digital Display Experience for Visitors

articles.summary: The South Dakota Department of Transportation (SDDOT) has contracted Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, to provide upgraded dynamic message signs (DMS) across the state as part of a wide-reaching transportation safety initiative.
articles.title: South Dakota Enhances Highway Safety with Upgraded Message Displays
